retrievalProfile.description: A structured grid layout featuring a large typographic header and multiple photographic panels with rounded corners, typical of 1960s pop culture media.

recipe.visualDefinition: A cream-colored background serves as a canvas for a top-heavy typographic hierarchy and a bottom-aligned grid of five photographic panels. The photos are arranged in three vertical columns, with the central column being a large portrait and the flanking columns containing two smaller stacked portraits each, all featuring rounded corners and thin black borders.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale block typography dominates the upper half of the composition.
A triptych-inspired photo grid anchors the bottom half.
Horizontal rules separate different tiers of text and imagery.
Rounded rectangular frames create a soft, television-screen aesthetic for the photos.
coreInvariants: Primary color palette for text (Red and Blue)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is centered and scaled to fill the top 40% of the frame; photography occupies the bottom 60% in a balanced grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central photograph of the main subject acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with the small metadata text, moving to the bold title, then the artist name, and finally resting on the photo grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous margins around the edges and between the text blocks prevent the dense information from feeling cluttered.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red and Royal Blue (Main titles)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation primary colors for text against a low-saturation, warm-toned background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point is integrated into the baseline of the title text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking different weights and colors of the same sans-serif family, separated by geometric lines.
graphicDevices: Small logo box in the upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the main title.
Provides the mid-century grotesque look for secondary headers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with a grid of five photos at the bottom. The grid should have one large central vertical photo and two smaller stacked photos on each side. All photos must have rounded corners and thin black outlines. Leave the top 40% of the image empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text in the top section. The top level is small blue sans-serif. The middle level is large, bold red uppercase sans-serif. The bottom level is large, bold blue uppercase sans-serif. Place thick black horizontal lines between the text blocks and above the photo grid.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream color?
Are there horizontal black lines separating the sections?
Is the main title text in a bold, condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of photos in the grid
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces
The MGM logo or specific record label branding
The exact wording of the soundtrack credits

mustAchieve: Consistent rounded corner radius across all photos

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Ensure the horizontal lines do not touch the edges of the frame.
Verify the cream background is uniform and not textured.
Confirm the photo grid is symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cream Background + (Stacked Bold Sans-Serif Typography in Red/Blue) + (Horizontal Rule Dividers) + (Symmetrical Grid of Rounded-Corner Photos)
